description: Search a provider's catalog using text and structured hints. Fuzzy matching, field interpretation, and ranking are provider-specific. This operation does not write user records.

main.description: Search a provider's catalog using text and structured hints. Fuzzy matching, field interpretation, and ranking are provider-specific. This operation does not write user records.

schema.description: Supply at least one nonblank q, title, author, or a nonempty identifiers array. Providers enforce this cross-field requirement.

q.description: Broad search text, which may describe a title, contributor, description, or identifier. Matching and ranking are provider-defined.

title.description: Title relevance hint, interpreted by the provider.

author.description: Author relevance hint, interpreted by the provider.

identifiers.description: Structured identifier relevance hints; search matching and ranking are provider-defined.

offset.description: Number of matching editions to skip in the provider's ordered result set.

limit.description: Maximum number of editions to return in this page.

errors.name: InvalidQuery
errors.description: No nonblank q, title, author, or nonempty identifiers array was supplied.
